name: Hungry!
summary: Mudcrush Durtfeet is hungry in northern Dustwallow Marsh and wants food from you. Bash the fishy Mirefin and bring back their heads, or Mud will eat you.

sections.title: A Hungry Ogre
sections.body: Mudcrush Durtfeet, an ogre called Mud, makes a plain bargain. Bash the fishy Mirefin and bring him their heads for food. Feed Mud, or he will eat you.

faq.answer: Mudcrush Durtfeet is a big ogre in northern Dustwallow Marsh, and he goes by Mud. He is hungry and wants food.

faq.q: What does Mudcrush Durtfeet want to eat?
faq.answer: Mud wants heads from the fishy Mirefin you are told to bash.

faq.q: What happens if you refuse to feed him?
faq.answer: Mud makes the choice plain: feed him, or he will eat you.
